mapper.insert: WITH stock_base AS ( SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.asset_code LIKE '0%' OR p.asset_code LIKE '1%' OR p.asset_code LIKE '2%' THEN 'KOSPI' ELSE 'KOSDAQ' END AS market_name, LAG(p.close_price) OVER w AS prev_close, LAG(p.close_price, 5) OVER w AS close_5d, LAG(p.close_price, 20) OVER w AS close_20d, LAG(p.close_price, 60) OVER w AS close_60d, LAG(p.close_price, 120) OVER w AS close_120d, LAG(p.close_price, 252) OVER w AS close_252d, LEAD(p.close_price, 20) OVER w AS forward_close_20d, AVG(COALESCE(p.volume, 0) * p.close_price) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS trade_amount_20d_avg, MAX(p.close_price) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS high_60d FROM market_daily_price p WHERE p.asset_type = 'STOCK' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date) ), stock_window AS ( SELECT b.*, STDDEV_POP( CASE WHEN b.prev_close > 0 THEN (b.close_price - b.prev_close) / b.prev_close ELSE NULL END ) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.asset_code ORDER BY b.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS vol_60d, STDDEV_POP( CASE WHEN b.prev_close > 0 THEN (b.close_price - b.prev_close) / b.prev_close ELSE NULL END ) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.asset_code ORDER BY b.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 251 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS vol_252d FROM stock_base b ), features AS ( SELECT #{modelCode} AS model_code, trade_date AS signal_date, asset_code, asset_name, market_name AS market, sector, CASE WHEN close_5d > 0 THEN (close_price - close_5d) / close_5d END AS ret_5d, CASE WHEN close_20d > 0 THEN (close_price - close_20d) / close_20d END AS ret_20d, CASE WHEN close_60d > 0 THEN (close_price - close_60d) / close_60d END AS ret_60d, CASE WHEN close_120d > 0 THEN (close_price - close_120d) / close_120d END AS ret_120d, CASE WHEN close_252d > 0 THEN (close_price - close_252d) / close_252d END AS ret_252d, vol_60d, vol_252d, CASE WHEN high_60d > 0 THEN (close_price - high_60d) / high_60d END AS drawdown_60d, trade_amount_20d_avg, CASE WHEN forward_close_20d > 0 THEN (forward_close_20d - close_price) / close_price END AS forward_return FROM stock_window WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND close_price > 0 AND close_60d IS NOT NULL ) INSERT INTO quant_core_feature_snapshot ( model_code, signal_date, asset_code, asset_name, market, sector, features, preprocessing_meta, label, forward_return, benchmark_return ) SELECT model_code, signal_date, asset_code, asset_name, market, sector, jsonb_build_object( 'ret5d', ret_5d, 'ret20d', ret_20d, 'ret60d', ret_60d, 'ret120d', ret_120d, 'ret252d', ret_252d, 'vol60d', vol_60d, 'vol252d', vol_252d, 'drawdown60d', drawdown_60d, 'tradeAmount20dAvg', trade_amount_20d_avg, 'riskAdjRet60d', CASE WHEN vol_60d > 0 THEN ret_60d / vol_60d END, 'riskAdjRet252d', CASE WHEN vol_252d > 0 THEN ret_252d / vol_252d END ), jsonb_build_object( 'source', 'market_daily_price', 'preprocessing', 'raw rolling features; model transforms pending', 'lookAheadSafe', true ), CASE WHEN forward_return >= 0.08 THEN 'WINNER' WHEN forward_return <= -0.05 THEN 'LOSER' WHEN forward_return IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'NEUTRAL' END, forward_return, NULL FROM features ON CONFLICT (model_code, signal_date, asset_code) DO UPDATE SET asset_name = EXCLUDED.asset_name, market = EXCLUDED.market, sector = EXCLUDED.sector, features = EXCLUDED.features, preprocessing_meta = EXCLUDED.preprocessing_meta, label = EXCLUDED.label, forward_return = EXCLUDED.forward_return, benchmark_return = EXCLUDED.benchmark_return
mapper.select: SELECT id, model_code AS modelCode, signal_date AS signalDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, market, sector, features::text AS features, preprocessing_meta::text AS preprocessingMeta, label, forward_return AS forwardReturn, benchmark_return AS benchmarkReturn, created_at AS createdAt FROM quant_core_feature_snapshot WHERE model_code = #{modelCode} AND signal_date = #{signalDate} ORDER BY (features->>'riskAdjRet60d')::numeric DESC NULLS LAST, (features->>'ret60d')::numeric DESC NULLS LAST, asset_code LIMIT #{limit}
